notes: A small, complete Claude Code budget-fuse plugin: Stop-hook spend recomputation from local transcripts, $50 auto-arm on /goal, loop-detection heuristic with the cap as deterministic backstop, and a self-exemption so the fuse cannot lock the user out. Published as a single-day, 2-commit v1.0.0 (history developed off-repo), but with tests, CI, CHANGELOG, spikes doc, and an unusually candid limitations section. Shares the house tag-on-merge/tests.yml/companion-badge pattern with pm-skills and claude-usage.
